# epitelesis

> ἐπιτέλεσις — the process of executing-to-completion. Fleet-wide command-execution wrapper substrate.

## Library

The public surface is the single Rust crate under `crates/epitelesis/`. See
the crate-root rustdoc and [README.md](README.md) for the API summary.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): crate role and module layout
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): current phase and consumers
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted decisions

## Agent entry points

- [README.md](README.md): public surface and quickstart
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent conventions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): dispatch conventions
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): module roles + SemVer contract
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting policy
